title: Connected Free-Space Regions in an Occupancy Grid
hints: Scan cells in row-major order. Each free cell that is still unlabelled starts a new region: give it the next label and flood-fill from it.
Use an explicit `std::queue<std::pair<int,int>>` (BFS), not recursion. A 1000×1000 free map would recurse 10⁶ deep and overflow the stack.
Label a cell when you PUSH it, not when you pop it, otherwise the same cell enters the queue several times.
4-neighbours: `const int dr[4] = {1,-1,0,0}, dc[4] = {0,0,1,-1};` and bounds-check before indexing.
